jobs.title: Overview
jobs.description: InfrOS Product: Adaptive Cloud Infrastructure Design Engine Product Partners About Careers Pricing Blog Videos App Sign in Build an Infrastructure That Evolves With You InfrOS is the intelligent engine for designing and deploying bespoke IT infrastructure. Move from business requirements to optimized, production-ready code, and eliminate the risk of manual error and over-provisioning. IT Infrastructure is Complicated We Know Your Pain Most teams struggle with the same recurring challenges. A systematic solution is needed because no human can manually process every variable to find the optimal configuration. Painful Deployments Manual configurations are slow, error-prone, and lead to performance issues that only appear under load. Complex Migrations Moving between clouds or from on-prem is a high-risk, high-cost project that often disrupts business operations. Constant Re-optimization Your business is a living system. As your code, needs, and cloud services evolve, your infrastructure constantly falls out of optimization. Bespoke Solutions Across Use Cases Use Cases AI Training Platform Requirement Train CV models, sub-100ms inference with 10M users Solution GPU clusters, model serving, caching, CDN E-commerce Platform Requirement Handle 50K orders/day, 99.9% uptime, global reach Solution Multi-region setup, databases, payment gateways Mobile Gaming Backend Requirement Support 1M concurrent players, real-time multiplayer Solution WebSocket clusters, Redis, global load balancing Healthcare SaaS Requirement HIPAA compliance, 24/7 availability, data encryption Solution Encrypted storage, audit trails, redundant systems Resource Downloads Product brochures & case studies Digital Services Cloud Migration POC Case Study CyberSecurity Enterprise Case Study The Intelligence Layer That Accelerates Cloud Provider Growth Brochure Intelligent Infrastructure Optimization Engine Brochure How it Works Your Four Steps to an Optimized Cloud We built InfrOS to be a true Infrastructure Operating System. It combines sophisticated modeling and real-world benchmarking to deliver infrastructure that is perfectly aligned with your business objectives. Layer 1 Multi-Agent RAG Architecture Advisory Our seven specialized AI agents, trained on extensive knowledge bases of best practices, analyze your requirements across seven distinct dimensions: performance, reliability, security, cost, scalability, maintainability, and deployment complexity. Layer 2 Mathematical Modeling for System Design With hundreds of mathematical functions, our engine moves beyond simple estimates. It precisely models workload patterns, capacity needs, and resource interdependencies to prevent over-provisioning and ensure your architecture can handle real-world demand. Layer 3 Deep-Learning Architecture Prediction Models Our machine learning models analyze your system's unique characteristics to create an architectural fingerprint. They then identify proven solutions from similar use cases, leveraging historical data to inform personalized, effective recommendations. Layer 4 Comprehensive Benchmarking & Simulation Lab Before you deploy a single line of code, our framework simulates how the proposed architecture will perform under load. This validates performance, identifies potential bottlenecks, and verifies the design meets your specified KPIs. Multi-objective Optimization by Design Go Beyond Fine-tuning. Build for the Future. Faster Time to Value Drastically reduce the time from concept to deployment. Our engine produces deployable, open-source Terraform code, turning months of architectural work into weeks. Optimized Performance per Dollar We excel at efficiency, not just cost-cutting. Get the highest possible performance for your investment, ensuring your cloud spend is directly contributing to business value. Built-in Resilience & Availability Design a fault-tolerant, resilient cloud from day one. Embed security best practices and compliance guardrails directly into your architecture. Continuous Lifecycle Optimization InfrOS grows with you. As your business evolves, we keep your infrastructure optimized, ensuring you are always running on the best configuration for your current needs.
